**CI on `02b931d2e3` has exactly one root cause, and it is this PR's by construction, not a flake.** `Type Check · source gates` (job 106716606265) fails at `node scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs --self-test`: the live-tree pin 「every discovered AUTHORED file carries a ceiling today」 lists the 11 new `skills/*/evals/*.json` files; `Lint & Repo Gates` will red on the same script's main run (「hand-authored published bundle file carrying no ceiling」). Every other check is green or skipped; `Type Check · source gates` is green on `origin/main` `a251aaa` and its four predecessors. The ratchet's own remedy text says a `CEILINGS` row 「prices new text into the bundle that ships to every customer project, which is the maintainer ruling this ratchet implements — not a step an author takes while landing the file」 (`scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs` :573–:580), so the dev correctly did not add rows.

**Content review (against GitHub, not the report):** 13 files, all under `skills/*/evals/**`; +613/−17 (evals net +596 ≤ the +900 budget; every `SKILL.md` net 0); 12 json fixtures in the objectui shape, ids unique, `skill_name` = frontmatter name; spot-checked `objectstack-data/evals/objects-fields-relationships.json` and `objectstack-query/evals/filters-pagination-search.json` — prompts are real authoring requests, and every `must_contain` token sampled (12 of 12) occurs in that skill's own text on `origin/main`. `skip-changeset` matches the last three merged `skills/**`-only PRs. Report 5775276005 on #19714 read back.

**Waiting on one word from the maintainer (asked in chat):** A — this PR gains one commit adding the 11 `CEILINGS` rows pinned at their measured counts (the counts are in this PR's body), citing the batch #213 ruling; B — a separate maintainer-authorised PR adds the rows and both are hand-merged together; C — `evals/**` leaves the ratchet's priced population. The seat recommends A. Until that word, this PR stays draft and red on the ratchet only.

## 维护者速读(终稿)

席位:总监席(summon #27,`session_0129ZpnaBcYZZ51rCvQiXg6C`),2026-09-22T13:32Z。这是批 #213 第 2 项的交付,Tier H,等您人合。

**改了什么**:10 个发布 skill 每个新增 `evals/*.json`(objectui 同款形状),共 54 题,每题带 `must_contain` / `must_not_contain`;data 的占位 README 换成真实清单;另加一笔:`scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs` 里 11 行天花板,按实测 token 数钉死、零余量,注释引您原话。

**为什么改**:您在批 #213 同意「先补 evals,再切分超长 SKILL.md」,evals 是切分前后「切了没变差」的量具;天花板行是您第二次回字「天花板行按照你的意见就行」的执行(A 方案)。

**风险与代价**:发布包多 11 个文件、约 12k token,只在有人主动读 evals 时进上下文;棘轮把它们全部计价,以后每个文件只能缩不能长。回滚 = revert 一个 squash 提交。

**席位意见**:通过。内容抽查过,CI 全绿,不改任何 SKILL.md 文本;唯一带判断的是把 evals 计入棘轮,这是您定的。

**你要做的**:合并本 PR(Squash)。合并后 #19714 自动关闭,#19715(切分卡)解锁进 skills 车道。
